items.title: How Cloudflare detects MCP traffic and helps secure it
items.blurb: Cloudflare Gateway identifies MCP requests using protocol-level heuristics. Security teams can use that signal to find shadow MCP traffic, enforce Portal-only access for approved servers, and block direct connections on managed network…

items.title: Secure all your internal vibe-coded applications — in one click
items.blurb: Introducing Cloudflare Access for Workers. Attach an Access policy directly to a Worker and it applies everywhere that Worker runs — routes, custom domains, workers.dev, and previews — automatically.

items.title: Total eclipse of the Internet: traffic impacts in Iceland, Spain, and Portugal
items.blurb: Cloudflare's data shows a clear impact on Internet traffic from Iceland to Spain and Portugal, following the path of totality of the total solar eclipse that occurred on August 12, 2026.

items.title: Certificate Transparency Monitoring is now generally available
items.blurb: Cloudflare's Certificate Transparency Monitoring is now generally available. The biggest change: we no longer email you about certificates Cloudflare issued for your domain, so when an alert lands in your inbox, it's worth a look.

items.title: How to bring your software delivery workflow into GitHub with agent apps
items.blurb: See how four GitHub agent apps can help you scope, secure, roll out, and ship a feature across the SDLC–all without leaving GitHub.

items.title: What 50 open source projects taught us about security in the AI era
items.blurb: See how the open source projects in Session 4 of the GitHub Secure Open Source Fund combined AI-assisted workflows, maintainer expertise, GitHub security tools, expert guidance, and funding to improve project security.
